classes.parsed: column 1 only (trade timestamp): row count, minimum, maximum, nanoseconds

clock: T0 = minimum column-1 timestamp of the first in-window daily file, in nanoseconds; E = T0 + 7 d up to the next whole minute; X = E + 7 d
cut_rules: X > cut censors the path and X == cut is allowed; lookback needs E - 30 d >= window start; every API span ends at cut - 1 ms; a row from the cut is dropped uncounted from an API page and stops the run in a first file, as does a row before the window start

limits.byte_rule: a request starts only if used + response cap + read reserve fits the go budget and the class budget; every received byte is accounted; a declared length over the cap reads nothing; Accept-Encoding is identity
limits.ret_code_rule: retCode must be an int and not a bool; a nonzero code keeps only retCode and a short retMsg; only 10006 and 10018 (rate limit) and 10000 and 10016 (transient) are retried; any other code stops the run naming it

output_root: outside the Git tree and disjoint from the sealed metadata root, checked before any file or HTTP client exists
public_report: aggregate counts only: no symbol, slot, URL, per-launch date or result; M4 diagnostics by launch quarter and delivery state
publish_order: the sealed source, the clean revision and the publication of every bound file are verified again before any queue, report or done marker is published; a failure writes the fixed stop source_integrity_error

queue.gate: Go B needs Go A in the same root, the sha256 of queue_b.json, and no definitive stop code from Go A
queue.go_a: D2 for every sealed launch with first_file_day and an ok HEAD size, sorted by opaque slot; preflight binds launches, files and bytes to the public record
queue.go_b: D3, D4, D5 and the first D6 page per candidate, sorted by opaque slot; later D6 pages by the HYP-036 rule, at most four per candidate
queue.t0_ambiguous: a launch whose T0 is ambiguous gets no request after Go A

reducer_rules: first file: exactly one gzip member, no trailing byte, every row inside the window; API bars: start on the step grid, inside the hour (or minute) containing the requested start and the requested end, no duplicate; funding rows inside [startTime, endTime], no duplicate; a row from the cut is dropped uncounted; any other deviation is a fixed schema stop
report_command: prints a stored report only if its go finished, or if a stop sealed the root and the report is not positive
restart: fresh root; no resume under different code; a stop seals the root
retention: sealed 0700 root; opaque slots and keys, no symbol, URL or raw body hash in any receipt; public output is aggregate counts only
success: stage1b_pass_partial is a coverage statement, never an economic result

verdict_rules.floor: n_primary at least 100 and at least 26 ISO weeks of primary launches
verdict_rules.go_a: Go B is allowed only with no stop code from M1, M2, M3 or the floor upper bound, no stop state and no pending first file; M4, M5, M6 and n_primary are decided only after Go B
verdict_rules.m1: d = first trade - launchTime; aligned -5 min to +60 min, delayed_open up to +24 h, else premarket_or_ambiguous; ambiguous at most 10%, readable at least 90%, unreadable at most 15%, all over the catalog launches
verdict_rules.m2: (i) no file within one day of launch, at most 5% of the catalog; (ii) the metadata share a/(N+a), at most 5%; (iii) candidates missing more than 5% of their V1 path days, at most 5% of the candidates
verdict_rules.m3: survivors are readable launches with a file near launch; contradicting at most 10%, unverifiable (no listing or unverified filename identity) at most 20%, survivors less contradicting at least 100; no baseCoin check
verdict_rules.m4: pagination finished and no gap longer than 8 h over days 3 to 21 after T0, clipped to the window: partial_pass, never proof; uncovered at most 5% of candidates; a share above the limit over the fixed candidate count is a known failure even while launches are pending
verdict_rules.m5: entry bar at E exists, hourly trade and mark series continuous from the hour of E to the hour before X, at least 95% of the episodes after funding; a series that may be cut by its limit is unproven and never green; minute level deferred; a known failure is an optimistic share below 95% (pending, unproven and funding-pending episodes counted as successes)
verdict_rules.m6: static catalog fields: minNotionalValue at most USD 50, maxLeverage at least 2, qtyStep and minOrderQty present, at least 90% of the episodes; partial
verdict_rules.outcome: the first stop code of the known failures, else stage1b_stopped if the root is sealed, else stage1b_incomplete if a check is not assessed, else stage1b_a_complete after Go A, else stage1b_pass_partial
